name: Rivermark
description: A modest trade town of cobbled streets, the Golden Flagon, and a guarded eastern gate.

market_square.name: Market Square
market_square.description: Stall canvas snaps in the river wind. Fish-water slicks the cobbles, mixed with trampled straw. Most of Rivermark's trade passes through this square, along with plenty of its gossip. The watch keeps a post by the well, close enough to see the market and far enough away to miss most of the talk.
market_square.first_visit: The square opens before you, loud and bright after the quiet streets. Hawkers call weights and prices over one another.
ambience: A fishmonger argues over weights with a farmer. Neither seems likely to give in.
Two children chase a hoop between the stalls and apologise to no one.
A watchman leans on the well, keeping an eye on hands, not faces.
Behind the stalls, a mule makes its opinion known.
The river wind snaps the stall canvas.

counting_house.name: The Counting House
counting_house.description: A narrow stone building on the river quay, home to Rivermark's ledgers and tariff disputes. The clerks write in a hand no one else can read. Perhaps that's the point. It smells of ink, wax, and old paper, like money already counted.
ambience: A clerk's pen scratches on, heedless of visitors.
Coins are counted somewhere out of sight, at an easy pace.
Below the window, the river slaps the quay stones.

exits.label: Along the quay to Granary Row
Down the steps to the water

river_stair.name: The River Stair
river_stair.description: Forty worn steps lead from the quay to the water, ending at a stone landing with iron rings set into it. Everything Rivermark doesn't grow arrives here on the flat-bottomed boats from the estuary. Whatever the town can't account for leaves the same way. A tide-scale is cut into the steps, though no one has painted it in a generation. The river reads it anyway.
river_stair.first_visit: The quay wall blocks the town's noise. Below, the brown river moves faster than it looks.
ambience: A boat knocks its fenders against the landing twice, then settles.
Someone counts sacks off a gangplank in a language you almost know.
A hat drifts past on the river at the foot of the steps.
A porter eats on a bollard and watches the water do the work.
Gulls quarrel over the tide-line, then lose interest together.

exits.label: Up the steps to the Counting House
Along the quay to Granary Row
Down the stair to the towpath

tobins_goods.name: Tobin's Goods
tobins_goods.description: A trade-goods shop off the market square, with rope and salt in back and the better stock behind the counter. Tobin knows the price of everything, favours included, and keeps the same account for both.
ambience: Rope, tar, and salt compete for your nose.
Tobin brushes dust from a clean shelf.
A price is chalked out, then rewritten a copper higher.

the_anvil.name: The Anvil
the_anvil.description: Rivermark's smithy. The forge never quite goes out, and the smith still has plenty to say about guild prices. Blades, tools, and horseshoes hang in ranks. The good steel stays under the counter until Brenna decides you can see it.
ambience: The forge breathes like something asleep.
Hammer blows land in threes, then pause for judgement.
Quench-steam hisses up, then vanishes.

high_street.name: The High Street
high_street.description: Rivermark's spine runs from the market toward the inn and the east road. Shops and homes stand shoulder to shoulder. Everyone who wants to be seen, and a few who don't, walks this street twice a day. Word travels faster here than any cart.
ambience: A minstrel tunes the same string for the fourth time, still hopeful.
A drover leads his mule past, apologising to the shopfronts.
Someone greets a passer-by with a little too much warmth.
A shutter closes just as you look up.

west_gate.name: The West Gate
west_gate.description: The lesser gate, and it knows it. The timber arch stands in a stretch of wall the town stopped repairing when trade moved east. One side is propped up; the other is patched with mismatched quarry stone. Beyond it, the ford road crosses wet fields toward the farms and the burnt mill. One watchman stands here, posted where the watch sends a man it has given up on.
west_gate.first_visit: The arch is lower than you expected. Beyond it, the road is mud, not metalling. No one stops you. No one has stopped anyone here in a long while.
ambience: The gate leaf hangs from one hinge. It has for years.
A farm cart comes in empty and leaves emptier.
Wind off the flats carries the smell of standing water.
The watchman shifts his weight beneath the arch and keeps his eyes down.
Someone started a tally on the gatepost, then stopped halfway.

root_ash.name: Root & Ash
root_ash.description: The apothecary on the main street. Herbs dry overhead, stoppered bottles stand in ranks, and a ledger tracks who owes for remedies. Osric measures words as carefully as powders, and never gives more than asked.
ambience: Dried herbs whisper in the draught.
Something settles slowly in a stoppered jar.
Osric turns the pestle in patient circles.

granary_row.name: Granary Row
granary_row.description: Warehouses and grain-lofts crowd the lane behind the quay, tall and windowless. By day, carts, sacks, and tally-marks fill the row. After dark, it belongs to whoever wants it badly enough. Half of Rivermark's wealth sleeps in these lofts, so some of Rivermark stays awake to watch over it.
ambience: Grain sifts somewhere behind the boarded doors.
A tally-man chalks sacks without looking up.
Rats argue in the gap between two warehouses.
A loft door stands open by an inch.

exits.label: Along the quay to the Counting House
Along the quay to the river stair

flagon_common_room.name: The Golden Flagon
flagon_common_room.description: The Golden Flagon is the warm heart of Rivermark, with hearth-light on scrubbed tables, a job board by the door, and rooms upstairs for weary travellers. Mara Hearthstone runs it with flour on her apron and a ledger in her head. Most town business gets settled at these tables before anyone makes it official.
flagon_common_room.first_visit: The door swings shut behind you, and the road noise fades. Woodsmoke, fresh bread, and laughter from the far table greet you. Whatever else Rivermark is, this room feels on your side.
ambience: The hearth pops as a log settles.
Mara counts under her breath. Mugs, or debts.
A traveller sleeps sitting up, with most of their dignity intact.
Someone pins a fresh notice to the job board.
Two locals quietly argue about someone else.

flagon_cellar.name: The Flagon Cellar
flagon_cellar.description: Cool and dark beneath the Golden Flagon: grain sacks, kegs on their chocks, and a low sump where the river seeps in. Something has got into the stores. The lamplight doesn't reach the corners.
flagon_cellar.first_visit: The stairs open onto darkness, smelling of grain, damp stone, and something sour that has no place in a larder.
ambience: Something stirs behind the grain sacks, then goes still.
The river seeps into the sump and drips.
A keg creaks against its chocks.
Your lamp gutters in the still air.

exits.label: Up the stairs to the common room
Through the gap behind the north wall

east_gate.name: The East Gate
east_gate.description: Rivermark's one good gate is watched by men who know every familiar face and study the rest. Beyond the arch, the quarry road runs east into open country. The watch asks few questions of those leaving and saves them for those who return.
ambience: A gate-watchman compares a face with a memory, taking his time.
A cart rumbles through the arch, its tarps drawn tight.
Wind off the hills carries dust from far away.
A cutpurse studies the crowd. The watch studies him.
